description: This file implements the CalculatorManager class, which manages different calculator modes (standard, scientific, programmer), handles user interactions, manages memory and history, and communicates with the calculator engine and display callback. It provides methods for mode switching, command processing, memory operations, and display updates within a calculator application.

classes.name: CalculatorManager
classes.description: A class responsible for managing calculator modes, user interactions, memory, history, and communication with the calculator engine and display callback within a calculator application.

methods.name: SetPrimaryDisplay
methods.description: Updates the primary display with the given string, unless in history load mode.

methods.name: SetIsInError
methods.description: Sets the error state in the display callback.

methods.name: DisplayPasteError
methods.description: Displays an error message for invalid input.

methods.name: MaxDigitsReached
methods.description: Notifies that the maximum number of digits has been reached.

methods.name: BinaryOperatorReceived
methods.description: Notifies that a binary operator has been received.

methods.name: MemoryItemChanged
methods.description: Notifies that a memory item has changed.

methods.name: InputChanged
methods.description: Notifies that the input has changed.

methods.name: SetExpressionDisplay
methods.description: Updates the expression display with tokens and commands.

methods.name: SetMemorizedNumbers
methods.description: Updates the display with the current memorized numbers.

methods.name: SetParenthesisNumber
methods.description: Updates the display with the parenthesis count.

methods.name: OnNoRightParenAdded
methods.description: Handles the event when no right parenthesis is added.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the calculator to default mode, clears entries and memories, and sets degree mode.

methods.name: SetStandardMode
methods.description: Switches the calculator to standard mode.

methods.name: SetScientificMode
methods.description: Switches the calculator to scientific mode.

methods.name: SetProgrammerMode
methods.description: Switches the calculator to programmer mode.

methods.name: SendCommand
methods.description: Processes a command, handling mode changes and special functions.

methods.name: LoadPersistedPrimaryValue
methods.description: Loads a persisted value into the calculator engine.

methods.name: MemorizeNumber
methods.description: Memorizes the current display value.

methods.name: MemorizedNumberLoad
methods.description: Loads a memorized number into the primary display.

methods.name: MemorizedNumberAdd
methods.description: Adds the primary display value to a memorized number.

methods.name: MemorizedNumberClear
methods.description: Clears a specific memorized number.

methods.name: MemorizedNumberSubtract
methods.description: Subtracts the primary display value from a memorized number.

methods.name: MemorizedNumberClearAll
methods.description: Clears all memorized numbers.

methods.name: MemorizedNumberSelect
methods.description: Selects a memorized number for operations.

methods.name: MemorizedNumberChanged
methods.description: Updates a memorized number after modification.

methods.name: GetHistoryItems
methods.description: Retrieves history items for the current mode.

methods.name: GetHistoryItem
methods.description: Retrieves a specific history item by index.

methods.name: SetHistoryItems
methods.description: Sets multiple history items.

methods.name: OnHistoryItemAdded
methods.description: Handles the event when a history item is added.

methods.name: RemoveHistoryItem
methods.description: Removes a history item by index.

methods.name: ClearHistory
methods.description: Clears all history items.

methods.name: SetRadix
methods.description: Sets the number base (radix) for display and calculations.

methods.name: SetMemorizedNumbersString
methods.description: Updates the display with the current memorized numbers in the correct radix format.

methods.name: GetCurrentDegreeMode
methods.description: Returns the current degree mode (DEG, RAD, GRAD).

methods.name: GetResultForRadix
methods.description: Returns the current calculation result formatted for a specific radix.

methods.name: SetPrecision
methods.description: Sets the precision for calculations.

methods.name: UpdateMaxIntDigits
methods.description: Updates the maximum number of integer digits allowed.

methods.name: DecimalSeparator
methods.description: Returns the decimal separator character.

methods.name: IsEngineRecording
methods.description: Checks if the calculator engine is recording.

methods.name: IsInputEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the input is empty.

methods.name: SetInHistoryItemLoadMode
methods.description: Sets whether the calculator is in history item load mode.

methods.name: GetDisplayCommandsSnapshot
methods.description: Returns a snapshot of the current display commands.
